event.title: Artificial Intelligence Regulatory & Policy Landscapes
event.description:
• Date and Time: 10–11AM, Friday, November 6, 2026
  • Location: Virtual (zoom link provided upon registration)
  • Instructor: Danielle Gensch (State, Local, and International Government Librarian)

This seminar is part of The American Library Association's Government Documents Roundtable (ALA-GODORT) Friday Chats series (https://godort.libguides.com/fridaychats). Please register through the ALA-GODORT website to receive the Zoom link.

Generative artificial intelligence is almost everywhere we look, and researchers are considering its role and impact in a wide variety of fields. Several international, state, and local organizations provide policy and regulation repositories worth knowing about. Danielle Gensch, State, Local, and International Government Librarian at Stanford University Libraries will provide a brief tour of OECD, NCSL, NLC, and other helpful tools in the government information librarian’s kit. She will focus on key topics like data centers, energy, sustainability, and intellectual property. Please feel free to bring your own examples, particularly for federal resources, generally outside the scope of Danielle’s work and her slides.

event.title: First Fridays Collab Lab
event.description:
No scores, no charts, no pressure – just collaboration!

Whether you are a seasoned musician, a shower singer, or someone who enjoys clapping on the off-beat – this space is for you! The Collab Lab is an open playground to create spontaneous sound. Come to listen, respond, noodle, experiment, and  build a creative community across genres and skill levels.

Open to Stanford faculty, staff, and students of all skill levels/instruments/voices.

Admission Information

  • Free admission
  • Parking permits are required for weekday campus parking. We recommend downloading the ParkMobile app before arriving.

event.title: Knight Initiative - Rosenkranz Aging Symposium
event.location: Li Ka Shing Center (LKSC), Paul Berg Hall
event.location_name: Li Ka Shing Center (LKSC), Paul Berg Hall
event.description:
Knight Initiative - Rosenkranz Aging Symposium

We invite the community to a symposium highlighting recent progress in brain resilience and aging research. A “topics in neuroscience” poster session will follow the talks and showcase the latest research from Stanford community members.

Registration is required to attend this in-person only event.

This symposium is a joint effort of the Knight Initiative for Brain Resilience and Rosenkranz Aging and Rejuvenation Grant Program.

Featuring the following speakers and more:

  • Luigi Ferrucci - National Institute on Aging (National Institutes of Health)
  • Botond Roska - Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel
  • Henne Holstege - VIB-KU Leuven Center for Neuroscience, Amsterdam UMC
  • Ashley Webb - Buck Institute for Research on Aging 
  • Felix Christian Boos - (Brunet Lab) Stanford University
  • Yue Sun - (Shen Lab) Stanford University

Registration

Registration is free and required. Please register by November 3.

Interested in presenting a poster?

Poster session sign-ups will be available through the registration form. Spots are limited and will be first-come, first-served until capacity is reached, at which point a waitlist may be opened. Register and finalize poster details by November 3.
